schedulingAmendment: After Pro finished, the original lane resumed at a committed boundary with a six-worker queue. Per-run attempt order, round barriers, inputs, output limits, validation, scoring, milk schedules and $100 lane cap are unchanged. Completed episodes are skipped.

budgetChanges.authorization: User: new budget is 500usd. User explicitly retained Pro.
budgetChanges.allocation: Original lane capped at $100, including prior Pro calls; new Pro lane capped at $400. Sum cannot exceed $500.

protocol.selection: Gateway catalogues fetched 2026-10-21. General text models created since 2026-04-21 inclusive. Snapshot aliases deduplicated; audio, realtime, image and embeddings excluded. OpenAI and Anthropic only as requested. chat-latest is a rolling alias.
protocol.pricing: Standard public rates, no gateway surcharge per user. Reserve all input at highest published cache-write price, all output including reasoning. Anthropic cache creation/read tokens added to fresh input. No explicit prompt caching requested. Errors retain full reservation, never retried automatically. Estimates, not invoices.
protocol.ordering: Attempt rounds 1..5, then matched seed, then interleaved provider models and paired modes, reverse model/mode ordering on even rounds. Six concurrent independent episodes. Stop before reservation would exceed $100.
protocol.interface: Identical prompts, physical space, client validation and two repairs. Anthropic unsupported numerical/length schema constraints moved to descriptions and checked client-side. Native adaptive thinking medium/low. OpenAI medium/low except Pro medium/medium and Instant chat-latest default. Equal output caps, not equal compute.
protocol.memory: Fresh requests only. No-notes equals fresh target, current visible milk and parameter guide. Both arms reflect; control discards reflection. Notes carries its own latest replacement note only. No SDK memory, conversation IDs or previous response IDs. Gateway-side memory/routing not independently observable.
protocol.optimizer: Reuse first five evaluations of frozen v0.7 CMA-ES seeds 42,43,44; identical source hashes, task, conditions and generic initialization. No reference warm start. Mark as cached baseline.
protocol.limits: Heart only; practice milk schedules; no held-out shape/milk evaluation. Three seeds is exploratory, not a significance claim. Measures context adaptation, not weight training. Numerical passes can have a weak notch.

verification.memoryIsolation: Every stored request checked against fresh allowed context; gateway internals not observable
